subject: Weekly ops-sales-finance GPU alignment standup
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Wang <oliver@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Weekly ops-sales-finance GPU alignment standup

Team — kicking off this week’s sync. Attached is the latest forecast (sheet "sprint_view") that maps upcoming closes to GPU slot requests and burst needs. Key asks for today’s standup: 

- Sales: confirm which deals are still expected to close in Q1 2027 (highlighted in orange).
- Finance: confirm whether we can push the budget for burst credits for deals where MRR > $75k.
- Infra/Ops: sanity-check latency SLAs if we shift some traffic from hosted to dedicated for priority deals.

Quick context: Acme AI (DEAL-8342) pushed for a guaranteed 99th-pct token latency and is asking for a dedicated pool of 8 A100-equivalent slots during business hours for the pilot period. Oliver, I've included you for visibility — please flag anything off in the table.

Attachment: 20261202-forecast_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Wang <oliver@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Weekly ops-sales-finance GPU alignment standup

Thanks Mateo — I reviewed the sheet quickly. A couple of notes: 

- Acme AI: sales still expects close by 2027-01-18, but procurement is asking for a two-week security review (we should treat close as soft until procurement signs).
- I flagged two smaller deals (rows 23–24) that could be deprioritized for slot allocation if we need to free burst capacity.

Action: I'll update the forecast to mark Acme as "probable" and remove weeks 6–7 burst credits until procurement confirms.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
VP, Sales Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Wang <oliver@acmeai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Weekly ops-sales-finance GPU alignment standup

Understood. From a finance perspective: 

- We have contingency for one high-touch pilot per quarter but need approval to expand burst credits beyond the committed reserved pool. If Acme is a pilot (MRR projection > $75k) we can expedite approval, but we need a short justification (customer-facing SLA + estimated incremental ARR).
- Please add an "ARR uplift" column to the spreadsheet (Jordan/Mateo) so I can build a one-pager for FP&A approval.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Oliver Wang <oliver@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T12:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Weekly ops-sales-finance GPU alignment standup

Copy — infra notes on feasibility: 

- We can provision an isolated pool equivalent to 8 A100 slots, but doing so during business hours only (M–F, 8am–6pm PT) requires a short maintenance window for KV-cache warmup and slot prewarming (30–45 minutes) per day. Expect an initial 10–12% spike in latency during warmup for the first 20 minutes unless we route a percentage of traffic to a fallback model variant.
- If procurement insists on the strict 99th-pct SLA, recommend we advertise a scheduled warmup window in the onboarding doc and include a fallback policy (route to the hosted variant) in the contract.

I've uploaded the rough provisioning plan as a PDF: acme-deal-commit-matrix.pdf

Ben Carter
Head of Infrastructure

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Wang <oliver@acmeai.com>, Procurement - Acme AI <procurement@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T13:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Weekly ops-sales-finance GPU alignment standup

Thanks all — consolidating next steps below: 

1) Jordan: update the forecast sheet (mark Acme as "probable", add ARR uplift column) and share new link by EOD today.
2) Laura: once Jordan shares updated ARR uplift I will draft the two-paragraph business case for FP&A; target approval window Tue 2026-12-07.
3) Ben/Infra: prepare the short provisioning runbook (30–45m warmup) and a suggested fallback routing policy. Share by Monday.
4) Procurement/Oliver: can you confirm the expected end-to-end review timeline? Procurement's two-week review will push our pilot start; if that's correct we'll push pre-provisioning to 2027-01-05.

I’ll run a short standup on Monday (10:30 PT) to validate the provisioning plan and signoffs. If anyone needs time to prep, flag it now — otherwise I'll send the calendar invite.

Best — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
